title: This thing is a cyclone!
text: This thing is a cyclone!. Warning...only fill your cup about a third of the way and blend or it will fly over the edge. It works great, it's quiet and easy.

product_metadata.title: Zulay Kitchen Premium One-Touch Milk Frother for Coffee - Easy-Use Frother Handheld Foam Maker - Electric Whisk Drink Mixer for Cappuccino, Frappe, Matcha and Hot Chocolate (Frosted White)
features: (New Features) Easy One Touch Button Operation: You no longer have to hold down the button to mix your coffee, just simply tap the button to turn your frother on and off and experience the power and ease. This Milk Boss Frother also gives you a thicker, more comfortable grip with it’s new larger base. We’ve also changed the battery compartment to lay the batteries side by side instead of stacked to make it easier to put in and take out the batteries when it’s time to change them.

Matcha Whisking, Coffee & More: Works better than a manual matcha whisk for making matcha tea and works far better than fork or whisk for coffee. It works very well to mix nutritious protein powder drinks with no extra container, blender or bottle shaker to wash. Use our mini mixer for your whisking and mixing needs: Give healthy shakes and smoothies a kick by adding whey powder or egg nog flavor and mixing.

Proven and Trusted Quality: We use only premium materials. The construction will last, backed by our Zulay Guarantee to not rust or break, ever. Our small and efficient frother works on all types of milk - half and half, creamer, soy, almond, cashew, hazelnut, whole milk, and other dairy such as butter or cream. PROP 65 WARNING: This product may contain chemical(s) known to the State of California to cause cancer, birth defects and/or other reproductive harm.

Easy To Clean and Store: The durable, convenient metal stand gives easy access for foamy goodness in seconds. Cleanup for this matcha wisk & frother is even faster. To clean just put the whisk in hot running water and briefly turn it on – instantly clean! When stored on counter or table it sits nicely next to other coffee accessories. Our powerful and durable hand-held milk frother is powered by two AA batteries (not included) with a compact electric design that easily fits in a drawer.

No Hassle, Zulay Guarantee: We love and take pride in our milk frother and we back this up with a lifetime guarantee. Have the confidence that this frother will last, if there are ever any issues, just contact us and we will make it right. Order now and be assured that this product will live up to your expectations, guaranteed. If it does not make your foam exactly how you want it, we got you covered.
